local house=false; local g='LOC_CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_TAIKO_LAND_SURVEY_NAME'; local O=JAC_HouseNamesBaseLocale; if O==nil then error('Locale wrapper not installed in this context') end; local gs=O.Lookup(g); local taiko=function(s) return string.find(s or '','太閤',1,true)~=nil or string.find(s or '','Taik',1,true)~=nil end; if not taiko(gs) then error('C25 is not the Taiko survey: '..gs) end; local has=function(s,t) return string.find(s or '',t,1,true)~=nil end; local who=PlayerConfigurations[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]:GetCivilizationTypeName(); local id='CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_TAIKO_LAND_SURVEY'; local section; for _,s in ipairs(GetSections()) do for _,p in ipairs(GetPages(s.SectionId)) do if p.PageId==id then section=s.SectionId; if p.Title~=gs then error('page title changed: '..tostring(p.Title)) end end end end; if section==nil then error('no Civilopedia page for '..id) end; NavigateTo(section,id); local head=Controls.PageHeaderCaption:GetText() or ''; if not has(head,Locale.ToUpper(gs)) then error('page header lacks the name: '..head) end; if JAC_LocalHouseHasNames()~=house then error('JAC_LocalHouseHasNames is wrong') end; if next(JAC_HOUSE_NAMES)~=nil then error('the pack registers a house-specific name: '..tostring(next(JAC_HOUSE_NAMES))) end; print('[JAC_HOUSE] state=Civilopedia local='..who..' header='..head); return head

steps.code: local house=false; local g='LOC_CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_TAIKO_LAND_SURVEY_NAME'; local O=JAC_HouseNamesBaseLocale; if O==nil then error('Locale wrapper not installed in this context') end; local gs=O.Lookup(g); local has=function(s,t) return string.find(s or '',t,1,true)~=nil end; local who=PlayerConfigurations[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]:GetCivilizationTypeName(); local p=Game.GetLocalPlayer(); local found=0; for _,id in ipairs(NotificationManager.GetList(p) or {}) do local n=NotificationManager.Find(p,id); if n then local raw=(n:GetMessage() or '')..' | '..(n:GetSummary() or ''); if has(raw,gs) then found=found+1; local shown=Locale.ToUpper(Locale.Lookup(n:GetMessage()))..' | '..Locale.Lookup(n:GetSummary()); if not (has(shown,gs) or has(shown,Locale.ToUpper(gs))) then error('notification lost the name: '..shown) end; local e=GetNotificationEntry(p,id); local panel=''; if e and e.m_Instance then panel=(e.m_Instance.TitleInfo:GetText() or '')..' | '..(e.m_Instance.Summary:GetText() or ''); if not (has(panel,gs) or has(panel,Locale.ToUpper(gs))) then error('panel lost the name: '..panel) end end; print('[JAC_HOUSE] state=NotificationPanel local='..who..' type='..tostring(n:GetTypeName())..' raw='..raw..' shown='..shown..' panel='..panel) end end end; if found==0 then error('no notification names the civic') end; return found
